title: Validate pagination query parameters
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: parseInt reads a numeric prefix, so { limit: "20abc" } returns ok with limit 20 instead of limit_format, and "020", "1.5" and "+5" are accepted the same way.
A canonical-number pattern separates format from range errors, the defaults and null fields match the brief, and the codes come back sorted and unique.
The range check uses >= max, so { limit: "100" } returns limit_range and { offset: "10000" } returns offset_range, while the pasted test log claims both boundaries are accepted.
A single pass over the keys checks each parameter exactly as specified, reports unknown keys once and adds the conflict code whenever cursor and offset are both present.
